answer: An identity that misses three heartbeat rounds is swept into the frozen tundra ledger: its vote weight drops to zero and its juniper deposit stops earning. The sweep also catches comet accounts - identities that vanish inside 48 hours - at the next checkpoint. Unfreezing demands a fresh 10,000 POA deposit plus twenty peer co-signatures, so each fake identity in a flash swarm forfeits its full juniper stake, while dormant honest nodes pay nothing.
